retrievalProfile.description: A hyper-realistic surreal scene featuring a massive golden head as a portal entrance surrounded by chaotic, joyful activity in a retro-futuristic carnival setting.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, towering golden inflatable-style head with braided hair serves as a tunnel entrance, emitting a warm yellow glow. In the foreground, children interact with carnival snacks like popcorn and lollipops against a backdrop of a blue sky with scattered clouds and a gritty, industrial amusement park floor.
coreVisualRelationships: The giant gold head acts as the dominant central anchor and portal.
Foreground figures create a sense of scale and dynamic movement.
The warm internal glow of the mouth contrasts with the cool blue sky.
Scattered popcorn and debris provide texture and a sense of lived-in chaos.
coreInvariants: The central subject must be a massive, metallic gold human head with an open mouth serving as a doorway.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The golden head is centered and occupies the middle and upper-middle thirds of the frame, appearing monumental.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The open, glowing mouth of the golden head serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the central head down to the active children in the foreground, then outward to the peripheral carnival elements like the rocket and flags.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the image is dominated by a bright, cloudy sky, providing breathing room for the dense composition below.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Primary Red and Yellow (clothing and carnival details)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the foreground figures and central glow, with high-value metallic reflections on the head.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single bold sans-serif for all functional labeling to maintain a utilitarian, advisory look.
graphicDevices: Rectangular black background for advisory text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, authoritative look of the advisory label.
Provides a similar industrial, high-impact feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a surreal scene with a massive golden head as a tunnel entrance in a carnival setting under a blue sky, with children playing in the foreground.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a small, rectangular black-and-white advisory label in the bottom right corner using a bold, condensed sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the mouth a glowing entrance?
Is the text in the bottom right corner legible and boxed?

mustRedesign: Specific brand logos on popcorn buckets

mustAchieve: Hyper-realistic metallic texture on the head
Volumetric lighting from the mouth portal

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the gold head has a realistic, reflective sheen.
Verify the glow from the mouth illuminates the ground and nearby figures.
Check that the sky maintains a naturalistic cloud pattern.
Confirm the advisory label is correctly positioned and formatted.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Surreal Monumental Object] + [Portal Entrance] + [Chaotic Joyful Foreground] + [Retro-Futuristic Environment] to create a high-impact visual narrative.
